title: Anna-Maria was a great guide
text: Anna-Maria was a very good guide. The pace of the tour was just right. I have been to Sevilla before but I learned many new to mee interesting facts. I would definitely recommend doing this at the beginning of your trip to get to know the city. Hope Anna-Maria will be your guude too!!
author: 113ruudl

title: Nice trip with excellent guide
text: Anna-Maria was a very good guide. The speed of the tour was good and learned a lot of interesting facts. Would definitely recommend to do this ik the beginning of your trip to get to know the city.
author: KathelijnVe

title: Excellent tour
text: When we turned up we had actually booked for the wrong day but they were so helpful and it was no trouble to include us in that afternoon’s tour. Our guide was friendly and very knowledgeable. Definitely the best way to see Seville
author: Fourtyplus

title: We had such a wonderful...
text: We had such a wonderful bike tour with Anna Maria! She was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and made the whole experience so enjoyable. I learned so much from her and really loved discovering the city by bike. Ana Maria truly made the tour special. Highly recommended!
author: Tamara_B

title: Good overview tour with...
text: Good overview tour with time to explore at a few stops. Not as much info as we’ve gotten in some other tours. E-bikes were really helpful - there were some hills that were challenging for people on regular bikes.
author: Elizabeth_M

title: 60 years bike tour
text: Good morning, we did this tour directly with them; at the beginning there was no guide in Italian and this annoyed us a bit, then the girl suggested the guide in Spanish with instant translation into Italian and so we accepted. Ben was very nice with simple explanations, I must say that overall it was a positive and fun experience. I recommend booking directly from their site because if there are any problems they accommodate your requests and if they can, also financially.
author: 262rosangelat

title: Great bike experience...
text: Great electric bike experience that allows you to discover certain parts of the city that are otherwise too remote.
author: Helene_L
